item.title: RCMP Update on Tumbler Ridge High School Shooting | Feb 10, 2026
item.description: The RCMP provides an official update following a tragic shooting at the local high school in Tumbler Ridge, BC. Authorities have confirmed 10 fatalities, including the suspect, who is believed to have died by suicide at the scene. In this press conference: Official casualty count and status of the investigation. Timeline of the events on February 10. Resources for affected families and community members. item.description: Premier David Eby provides an update to British Columbians following the devastating shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School and a local residence. The Premier discusses the province’s immediate response, the deployment of mental health supports for the community, and shares a message of solidarity with the families of the 10 lives lost.
